name: Zeltplatz Oberhart
beschreibung: The Zeltplatz Oberhart is located in Kolbermoor in Tirol, Österreich, and offers guests a close-to-nature place to stay in the Alpen. The surroundings are characterized by mountain landscapes and expansive meadows, which are suitable for various outdoor activities. Nearby are hiking trails of varying difficulty levels, suitable for both families and experienced mountain hikers. In the winter months, ski areas in the region are accessible, offering a variety of slopes and cross-country ski trails. The campsite has basic sanitary facilities and pitches for tents. The atmosphere at the site is quiet and shaped by the alpine natural surroundings. Guests find here a starting point for activities in the Tiroler Bergen as well as for exploring the surrounding villages.
